subject.title: refactor(config): config-surface reduction tranche 1 — retire dead keys, dedupe channel schemas, add growth ratchet

question: Should this tranche preserve the published `TelegramDmThreadReplies` type alias through a defined SDK deprecation window, or has an explicitly approved SDK-breaking release authorized removing it now?
rationale: The repository policy requires a named compatibility/deprecation path for shipped external Plugin SDK APIs, and selecting a breaking-release boundary is an owner decision rather than a mechanical refactor choice.

options.title: Keep a deprecated type alias
options.body: Restore a type-only `TelegramDmThreadReplies` export with a named deprecation path while runtime config remains canonical-only.

options.title: Approve an SDK-breaking removal
options.body: Accept the external plugin compile break only with explicit release/versioning approval and clear upgrade communication.

recommendation.title: Keep a deprecated type alias
recommendation.body: Restore a type-only `TelegramDmThreadReplies` export with a named deprecation path while runtime config remains canonical-only.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied commit history places steipete closest to the configuration and SDK-surface design in this PR.
